log.text: Light Screen up on P2's side
Light Screen ended on P2's side

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf blocks Whimsicott's Prankster via Armor Tail and sets Trick Room to invert Tailwind. Gardevoir Mega Evolves for Pixilate Hyper Voice spread pressure, which hits Ampharos-Mega 2x. Kingambit (Dark) is immune to Prankster, threatens with Iron Head, and cleans with Sucker Punch when Tsareena faints. Arcanine-Hisui cycles Intimidate and offers Extremespeed priority.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 plan: Farigiraf's Armor Tail neutralizes Whimsicott's Prankster. Mega Gardevoir's Pixilate Hyper Voice hits Basculegion/Politoed neutral and Ampharos-Mega super-effective. Kingambit's Dark typing grants Prankster immunity. Beware Tsareena's Queenly Majesty blocking Sucker Punch/Extremespeed. Basculegion's Last Respects must be eliminated before allies faint. If rain is set, Water moves become deadly—preserve Farigiraf's Sash for Trick Room reset.

decisions.rationale: Lead Whimsicott/Metagross to pressure the Fairy-heavy Trick Room core while retaining Prankster Trick Room as reversal control. Politoed can weaken Mystical Fire and enable rain offense; preserve Basculegion for late-game Adaptability and boosted Last Respects.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s established four: Farigiraf/Hatterene/Kingambit/Gardevoir. Farigiraf: Focus Sash, Armor Tail, Quiet; Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Hatterene: Life Orb, Magic Bounce, Quiet; Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Kingambit: Brave, Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord; Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Sucker Punch/Protect; Kowtow Cleave can OHKO full Metagross. Gardevoir: Modest, Gardevoirite; Hyper Voice/Psychic/Mystical Fire/Protect; Adaptability before Mega and Pixilate after Mega. Preserve Basculegion for late-game Adaptability pressure when practical. After two allied faints, Last Respects reaches 150 BP and is decisive into Psychic targets. Armor Tail blocks priority aimed at foes while Farigiraf remains. Politoed supports with rain, Helping Hand, and speed control. Whimsicott’s Trick Room is valuable for reversing established Trick Room. Avoid consecutive Protect unless forced.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gardevoir)
decisions.rationale: Trick Room + Protect is the safest turn-1 line. Gardevoir's +4 Protect blocks Metagross's priority Bullet Punch and any doubled attack. Farigiraf's Sash guarantees TR goes up unless they double into it (unlikely given Mega Gardevoir's threat). If Whimsicott Tailwinds, their own Tailwind becomes a liability under TR. If they cancel TR with their own, we reset to neutral but Gardevoir is unharmed. Turn 2 we Mega Evolve and attack under our speed control.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 (score 1-1): Turn 1 opened Farigiraf + Gardevoir vs Whimsicott + Metagross. Armor Tail blocks Prankster. Elected Trick Room + Protect. Farigiraf holds Focus Sash for TR reset if needed. Kingambit (Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord) and Arcanine-Hisui (Expert Belt, Intimidate) in back. Opponent has Basculegion (MysticWater, Adaptability — must eliminate before allies faint for Last Respects), Politoed (Drizzle), Tsareena (QueenlyMajesty blocks priority), Ampharos-Mega (Mold Breaker). Whimsicott carries both Tailwind and Trick Room — speed-control war critical.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Metagross)
decisions.rationale: Mirror Trick Room exploits priority: Prankster makes Whimsicott’s Trick Room act before Farigiraf’s -7 Trick Room, so the likely opposing setup toggles the room back off. Meteor Mash is a guaranteed OHKO on Mega Gardevoir if it hits; Mystical Fire cannot OHKO Metagross first.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s established four: Farigiraf/Hatterene/Kingambit/Gardevoir. Farigiraf: Focus Sash, Armor Tail, Quiet; Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Hatterene: Life Orb, Magic Bounce, Quiet; Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Kingambit: Brave, Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord; Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Sucker Punch/Protect; Kowtow Cleave can OHKO full Metagross. Gardevoir: Modest, Gardevoirite, Clear Body before Mega and Pixilate after Mega; Hyper Voice/Psychic/Mystical Fire/Protect. Preserve Basculegion for late-game Adaptability pressure when practical; after two allied faints, Last Respects reaches 150 BP and is decisive into Psychic targets. Armor Tail blocks priority aimed at foes while Farigiraf remains. Whimsicott’s Prankster Trick Room acts at -6, before ordinary -7 Trick Room, enabling same-turn cancellation against a foe using Trick Room. Meteor Mash guarantees an OHKO on Mega Gardevoir if it hits, but has 90% accuracy. Politoed supports with rain, Helping Hand, and Icy Wind. Avoid consecutive Protect unless forced.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gardevoir)
decisions.rationale: Metagross Meteor Mash threatens 85-203% OHKO on Gardevoir. Switching to Kingambit preserves my mega; Kingambit resists Steel (12-25% from Mash, 27-57% from Stomping Tantrum). Farigiraf sets Trick Room behind Sash. Next turn TR is up with Farigiraf+Kingambit moving first, and Gardevoir can re-enter later to Mega Evolve safely.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 (1-1): Turn 2 set Trick Room + switch Gardevoir to Kingambit. Opponent team: Whimsicott (Sash, Prankster, both Tailwind/TR), Metagross (Expert Belt), Basculegion (MysticWater Adaptability — eliminate before allies faint for Last Respects), Politoed (Drizzle, Sitrus), Tsareena (QueenlyMajesty blocks priority, Wide Lens), Ampharos-Mega (Mold Breaker, base 45 Speed — fastest under TR). My team: Farigiraf (Sash, Armor Tail), Kingambit (Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord), Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate), Arcanine-Hisui (Expert Belt, Intimidate). Speed-control war critical: Whimsicott can cancel TR or set Tailwind. Ampharos-Mega threatens under TR with Mold Breaker ignoring Armor Tail.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Metagross)
decisions.rationale: Repeat the Trick Room counter while Meteor Mash targets the highest immediate threat. If Farigiraf again sets Trick Room, Whimsicott moves first via Prankster and Farigiraf cancels it; Meteor Mash guarantees the Mega Gardevoir OHKO if it hits. This preserves the favorable speed state and avoids its reduced-success consecutive Protect.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s established four: Farigiraf/Hatterene/Kingambit/Gardevoir. Farigiraf is Quiet with Focus Sash, Armor Tail, and Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Hatterene is Quiet with Life Orb, Magic Bounce, and Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Kingambit is Brave with Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord, Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Sucker Punch/Protect; Kowtow Cleave can OHKO full Metagross. Gardevoir is Modest with Gardevoirite; Clear Body before Mega, Pixilate after; Hyper Voice/Psychic/Mystical Fire/Protect. Meteor Mash guarantees an OHKO on Mega Gardevoir if it hits but is 90% accurate. Armor Tail blocks priority aimed at foes while Farigiraf remains. Whimsicott’s Prankster Trick Room acts at -6 before ordinary -7 Trick Room, enabling same-turn cancellation. Preserve Basculegion for late-game Adaptability pressure when practical; after two allied faints, Last Respects reaches 150 BP and is decisive into Psychic targets. Politoed provides rain, Helping Hand, and Icy Wind support. Avoid consecutive Protect unless forced.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Kingambit)
decisions.rationale: Farigiraf TR continues the speed war; if Whimsicott Tailwinds instead, TR goes up and we win the speed flip. If both TR, Prankster makes Whimsicott's TR resolve at -6 before Farigiraf's -7, so Kingambit gets a brief TR window to Kowtow Cleave Metagross (71-121%) before Farigiraf cancels. Either way Kingambit pressures Metagross hard with a potential OHKO.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 (1-1): Opponent team Whimsicott (Sash/Prankster, both TR+Tailwind), Metagross (ExpertBelt/ClearBody), Basculegion (MysticWater/Adaptability — eliminate early to cap LastRespects), Politoed (Drizzle/Sitrus), Tsareena (WideLens/QueenlyMajesty blocks priority), Ampharos-Mega (MoldBreaker, base 45 Speed — fastest under TR). My team: Farigiraf (Sash/ArmorTail), Kingambit (BlackGlasses/SupremeOverlord), Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate), Arcanine-Hisui (ExpertBelt/Intimidate). TR war pattern: turns 1-2 both sides set then cancelled. Prankster TR is -6 vs our -7, creating mid-turn TR windows. Ampharos-Mega is the biggest TR threat with Mold Breaker ignoring Armor Tail. Basculegion must be eliminated before allies faint.

decisions.rationale: Gardevoir avoids Arcanine's 4x Ground weakness to Metagross Stomping Tantrum and 4x Water weakness to Politoed. Fairy typing grants Dragon immunity vs Ampharos-Mega, while Mystical Fire threatens Metagross and Pixilate Hyper Voice threatens Ampharos. Trace can copy Prankster for priority Protect if Whimsicott stays. Arcanine's Intimidate is blocked by Clear Body anyway.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 (1-1): Opponent team Whimsicott (Sash/Prankster, TR+Tailwind), Metagross (ExpertBelt/ClearBody), Basculegion (MysticWater/Adaptability — eliminate early to cap LastRespects at 50 BP), Politoed (Drizzle/Sitrus), Tsareena (WideLens/QueenlyMajesty), Ampharos-Mega (MoldBreaker, base 45 Speed — fastest under TR). My team: Farigiraf (Sash/ArmorTail/Quiet), Kingambit (fainted), Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate/Modest), Arcanine-Hisui (ExpertBelt/Intimidate). TR now up with 5 turns remaining; Farigiraf at 72 Speed moves before Metagross (90-122) under TR. Kingambit fainted turn 3, giving Supreme Overlord only +1 if revived — unlikely to matter. Gardevoir is primary counter to Ampharos-Mega (Dragon immunity, Pixilate SE). Arcanine vulnerable to Metagross Stomping Tantrum (4x) and Politoed Weather Ball rain (4x). Basculegion Last Respects still 50 BP; must eliminate before more allies faint. Future: use Gardevoir-Mega to pressure Ampharos and Metagross; preserve Farigiraf's Sash for emergency TR reset.

decisions.rationale: Double-target Kingambit: Whimsicott is guaranteed to move first, and Moonblast plus super-effective Stomping Tantrum has a strong chance to finish it. This is more proactive than Tailwind, since Stomping Tantrum alone cannot KO and would leave Metagross exposed to Kowtow Cleave.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s established four are Farigiraf/Hatterene/Kingambit/Gardevoir. Farigiraf: Quiet, Focus Sash, Armor Tail, Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Hatterene: Quiet, Life Orb, Magic Bounce, Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Kingambit: Brave, Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord, Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Sucker Punch/Protect; Kowtow Cleave can OHKO Metagross. Gardevoir: Modest, Gardevoirite; Clear Body pre-Mega, Pixilate post-Mega; Hyper Voice/Psychic/Mystical Fire/Protect. Meteor Mash guarantees an OHKO on Mega Gardevoir if it hits, but has 90% accuracy. Armor Tail blocks priority aimed at foes while Farigiraf remains. Prankster Trick Room acts at -6 before ordinary -7 Trick Room, allowing same-turn cancellation. Preserve Basculegion for late-game Adaptability pressure when practical; after two allied faints, Last Respects reaches 150 BP and is decisive into Psychic targets. Politoed provides rain, Helping Hand, and Icy Wind support. Avoid consecutive Protect unless forced.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf Dazzling Gleam breaks Whimsicott's sash and chips Metagross while Gardevoir Protects, dodging Metagross's SE Meteor Mash/Bullet Punch. This preserves Gardevoir, our main counter to Ampharos-Mega, and leaves Whimsicott vulnerable next turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 (1-1): Opponent Whimsicott (Sash/Prankster, TR+Tailwind), Metagross (ExpertBelt/ClearBody), Basculegion (MysticWater/Adaptability; LastRespects 50 BP after Kingambit fainted), Politoed (Drizzle/Sitrus), Tsareena (WideLens/QueenlyMajesty), Ampharos-Mega (MoldBreaker, base 45 Speed). My team: Farigiraf (Sash/ArmorTail/Quiet), Kingambit (fainted), Gardevoir (Gardevoirite/Pixilate/Modest), Arcanine-Hisui (ExpertBelt/Intimidate). TR up through turn 7. ArmorTail blocks priority moves targeting our side but not field/side moves like Tailwind or Light Screen. Gardevoir is primary Ampharos-Mega answer (Fairy immunity to Dragon). Preserve Gardevoir; break Whimsicott sash then eliminate; keep Arcanine for clean-up, but avoid Metagross's Ground moves and Politoed's rain-boosted Water attacks.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Metagross)
decisions.rationale: Prankster Light Screen immediately reduces both foes’ special pressure, including Mystical Fire into Metagross. Under Trick Room, Metagross is guaranteed to move before Gardevoir at equal priority; Meteor Mash threatens the established OHKO on Mega Gardevoir and remains strong if it does not Mega, with Protect being the main downside.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s established four are Farigiraf/Hatterene/Kingambit/Gardevoir. Farigiraf: Quiet, Focus Sash, Armor Tail, Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Hatterene: Quiet, Life Orb, Magic Bounce, Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Armor Tail blocks priority aimed at foes while Farigiraf remains. Prankster Trick Room acts at -6 before ordinary -7 Trick Room, enabling cancellation but allowing a later Farigiraf Trick Room to restore it. Preserve Basculegion for late-game Adaptability pressure when practical; after two allied faints, Last Respects reaches 150 BP and is decisive into Psychic targets. Politoed provides rain, Helping Hand, and Icy Wind support. Avoid consecutive Protect unless forced.

decisions.rationale: Metagross OHKOs Gardevoir with Meteor Mash and speed order is uncertain under TR. Switching Gardevoir preserves my Mega win condition and Ampharos-Mega answer. Farigiraf Dazzling Gleam chips both foes; Whimsicott's Sash is already broken at 77%. Arcanine takes 33-73% from Meteor Mash (likely click into Gardevoir's slot) and can threaten back next turn. Clear Body blocks Intimidate on Metagross but the switch is still safer than losing Gardevoir for free.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 (1-1): Whimsicott Sash broken at 77% HP. Light Screen up through turn 8. TR through turn 7. Kingambit fainted (Supreme Overlord 1). Basculegion Last Respects at 50 BP. Gardevoir is primary Ampharos-Mega answer (Fairy immune to Dragon). Metagross Clear Body blocks Intimidate. Preserve Gardevoir at all costs; Arcanine for clean-up but avoid Ground moves and rain Water attacks. Opponent likely to bring Politoed+Basculegion rain mode later.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Metagross)
decisions.rationale: Meteor Mash acts before Gardevoir under Trick Room and threatens the established guaranteed OHKO if it hits. Whimsicott then reverses Trick Room at priority -6, forcing Farigiraf to spend its -7 Trick Room restoring it or let the field return to normal.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Arcanine-Hisui)
decisions.rationale: Arcanine Protect (+4 priority) blocks the probable Stomping Tantrum KO from Metagross while Farigiraf sets Trick Room. If Whimsicott Tailwinds, TR+Tailwind gives me the speed edge next turn (Farigiraf 72 > Arcanine 134 > Metagross 180-244 under TR). If Whimsicott Tricks Room to cancel, Arcanine survives and KOs Whimsicott next turn. Preserves both mons for Gardevoir endgame vs Ampharos-Mega.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 (1-1): Whimsicott Sash broken at 77% HP. Light Screen up through turn 8. Kingambit fainted (Supreme Overlord 1). Basculegion Last Respects at 50 BP. Gardevoir is primary Ampharos-Mega answer (Fairy immune to Dragon). Metagross Clear Body blocks Intimidate. Preserve Gardevoir at all costs; Arcanine for clean-up but avoid Ground moves and rain Water attacks. Opponent has Politoed+Basculegion rain mode and Tsareena in back.

decisions.rationale: Prankster Tailwind immediately doubles Metagross’s Speed to 180, above Arcanine’s 142 maximum. Stomping Tantrum is 4x effective and guarantees the KO from 32%, preventing Flare Blitz; only Extreme Speed can precede it and cannot KO Metagross.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s Game 3 four: Farigiraf, Kingambit, Gardevoir, Arcanine-Hisui. Farigiraf is Quiet Focus Sash Armor Tail with Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Gardevoir is Modest Gardevoirite with Hyper Voice/Psychic/Mystical Fire/Protect; Mega gains Pixilate. Arcanine-Hisui is Adamant Expert Belt Intimidate with Head Smash/Flare Blitz/Extreme Speed/Protect. Kingambit is Brave Black Glasses Supreme Overlord with Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Sucker Punch/Protect. Armor Tail blocks foe-targeted priority while Farigiraf remains. Meteor Mash guarantees an OHKO on Mega Gardevoir if it hits. Preserve Basculegion when practical; after two allied faints, 150-BP Adaptability Last Respects is decisive into Psychic targets. Politoed offers rain, Helping Hand, and Icy Wind support. Prankster Trick Room acts at -6, before ordinary -7 Trick Room, so Farigiraf can cancel an initial setup or restore Trick Room afterward.

decisions.rationale: Arcanine at 33% with reduced Protect is almost certainly KO'd by Metagross Stomping Tantrum (4x Ground) before it can move under Trick Room. Switching preserves Arcanine for late-game Extreme Speed cleanup and brings Gardevoir safely into a neutral Stomping Tantrum (23-57% unboosted) rather than a risky Meteor Mash. Farigiraf Dazzling Gleam chips both foes under Light Screen before Metagross acts.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 (1-1): Whimsicott Sash broken at 77% HP. Light Screen up through turn 8, Tailwind through turn 9. Kingambit fainted (Supreme Overlord 1). Basculegion Last Respects at 50 BP. Gardevoir is primary Ampharos-Mega answer (Fairy immune to Dragon). Metagross Clear Body blocks Intimidate. Preserve Gardevoir at all costs; Arcanine for clean-up but avoid Ground moves and rain Water attacks. Opponent has Politoed+Basculegion rain mode and Tsareena in back. Farigiraf Sash intact.

decisions.rationale: Politoed pivots in before attacks and Drizzle halves Arcanine’s Flare Blitz, preventing a KO on Metagross even at the damaging extreme. Metagross then uses the verified 4×-effective Stomping Tantrum, which guarantees the KO from Arcanine’s shown range.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s Game 3 four: Farigiraf, Kingambit, Gardevoir, Arcanine-Hisui. Farigiraf is Quiet Focus Sash Armor Tail with Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Gardevoir is Modest Gardevoirite with Hyper Voice/Psychic/Mystical Fire/Protect; Mega gains Pixilate. Arcanine-Hisui is Adamant Expert Belt Intimidate with Head Smash/Flare Blitz/Extreme Speed/Protect. Kingambit is Brave Black Glasses Supreme Overlord with Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Sucker Punch/Protect. Armor Tail blocks foe-targeted priority while Farigiraf remains. Meteor Mash guarantees an OHKO on Mega Gardevoir if it hits. Preserve Basculegion when practical; after two allied faints, 150-BP Adaptability Last Respects is decisive into Psychic targets. Politoed’s Drizzle can protect Metagross from Arcanine-Hisui’s Flare Blitz; it also offers Helping Hand and Icy Wind support. Prankster Trick Room acts at -6, after ordinary attacks but before standard -7 Trick Room. Stomping Tantrum blocked by Protect does not receive doubled power.

decisions.rationale: Gardevoir must Protect to survive Metagross's priority Bullet Punch (guaranteed KO from 33%). Mega Evolving now gives Pixilate for future turns at no cost. Farigiraf Psychic chips Politoed through Light Screen; Light Screen expires after this turn, enabling stronger attacks next turn. Farigiraf's Sash keeps it safe from any single-target retaliation.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 (1-1): Whimsicott Sash broken. Kingambit fainted (Supreme Overlord 1). Basculegion Last Respects 50 BP. Gardevoir is primary Ampharos-Mega answer. Metagross Clear Body blocks Intimidate. Preserve Gardevoir; Arcanine for clean-up but avoid Ground/Water. Farigiraf Sash intact. Light Screen expires after turn 8, Tailwind through turn 9, TR 3 turns left, Rain 4 turns left.

decisions.rationale: Rain-boosted Weather Ball guarantees the KO on Mega Gardevoir from 32%, while +1 Meteor Mash pressures Farigiraf rather than redundantly targeting Gardevoir. This split also punishes either foe using Protect; rain prevents Mystical Fire from threatening a Metagross KO.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 opposing four: Farigiraf, Kingambit, Gardevoir, Arcanine-Hisui. Farigiraf: Quiet, Focus Sash, Armor Tail, Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Gardevoir: Modest, Gardevoirite, Hyper Voice/Psychic/Mystical Fire/Protect; Mega gains Pixilate. Arcanine-Hisui: Adamant, Expert Belt, Intimidate, Head Smash/Flare Blitz/Extreme Speed/Protect. Stomping Tantrum blocked by Protect does not gain doubled power.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Farigiraf Protect (100% success, unused) and Gardevoir Protect (33% consecutive). Even if Gardevoir's Protect fails and Bullet Punch KOs it, Farigiraf survives to preserve TR. 33% chance both survive and we keep both offensive threats under TR. Opponent likely targets Gardevoir with Bullet Punch and Farigiraf with Weather Ball; double Protect blocks both if Gardevoir's succeeds.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 (1-1): Whimsicott Sash broken. Kingambit fainted (Supreme Overlord 1). Basculegion Last Respects 50 BP. Gardevoir is primary Ampharos-Mega answer. Metagross Clear Body blocks Intimidate. Preserve Farigiraf for TR; Gardevoir for special offense. Arcanine in back for clean-up but avoid Ground/Water. Light Screen expired. Tailwind through turn 9, TR 2 turns left (turns 9-10), Rain 3 turns left. Farigiraf Protect unused this game; Gardevoir Protect used turns 4,8 (consecutive 1/3).

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Stomping Tantrum is accurate and guarantees the Farigiraf KO even without counting Metagross’s Attack boost, removing Armor Tail. Rain-boosted Weather Ball guarantees the Gardevoir KO if it does not Protect. Metagross safely survives rain-weakened Mystical Fire, while splitting targets limits the value of either foe protecting.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 opposing four: Farigiraf, Kingambit, Mega Gardevoir, Arcanine-Hisui. Farigiraf: Quiet, Focus Sash, Armor Tail, Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Mega Gardevoir: Modest, Hyper Voice/Psychic/Mystical Fire/Protect; Pixilate. Arcanine-Hisui: Adamant, Expert Belt, Intimidate, Head Smash/Flare Blitz/Extreme Speed/Protect. Kingambit: Brave, Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord, Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Sucker Punch/Protect. Armor Tail blocks foe-targeted priority while Farigiraf remains. Preserve Basculegion when practical; after two allied faints, Adaptability Last Respects reaches 150 BP and is decisive into Psychic targets. Rain protects Metagross from Fire pressure and powers Politoed’s Weather Ball. Prankster Trick Room resolves at -6, after ordinary attacks but before standard -7 Trick Room. Stomping Tantrum blocked by Protect does not gain doubled power. Unboosted Metagross Stomping Tantrum deals at least 36.9% to Farigiraf; rain-weakened Mega Gardevoir Mystical Fire deals about 21.9–25.8% to Metagross.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf Psychic into Politoed (29–51%) chips it before TR lets foes move; Arcanine Protect at +4 priority blocks the guaranteed OHKO from Weather Ball or Stomping Tantrum. Even if Farigiraf falls, Arcanine survives at 33% and next turn outspeeds without TR to threaten with Head Smash or Flare Blitz. No other combination preserves Arcanine while dealing meaningful damage.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 (1-1). Whimsicott Sash broken. Kingambit fainted (Supreme Overlord 1). Basculegion Last Respects capped at 50 BP. Gardevoir-Mega was primary Ampharos-Mega answer. Metagross Clear Body blocks Intimidate. Farigiraf is the TR setter; Arcanine-Hisui is the remaining physical attacker. Both foes can OHKO Arcanine with Water/Ground coverage. Farigiraf Sash still intact but irrelevant at 26% HP. Rain ends turn 11; TR ends after turn 10.

decisions.rationale: Split 100%-accurate attacks secure both threats: rain-boosted Weather Ball guarantees Arcanine’s KO, while Stomping Tantrum guarantees Farigiraf’s KO even without counting Metagross’s +1. Politoed acts before Arcanine under Trick Room, and Farigiraf cannot reset Trick Room before Metagross attacks.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf fainted, must pass. Arcanine is last mon at 33% vs two foes with guaranteed OHKO moves (Weather Ball 223%+, Stomping Tantrum 115%+). Head Smash into Politoed is the only move with KO potential (56.9-107.3% into 46% HP). Flare Blitz into Metagross maxes at 63.2% (not enough). Protect is unreliable after consecutive use. No path to win; best play is to attempt the KO on Politoed.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 (1-1). Lost. Farigiraf, Kingambit, Gardevoir-Mega all fainted. Arcanine-Hisui last mon at 33% vs Politoed (46%) + Metagross (80%) + Whimsicott/Basculegion/Tsareena/Ampharos in back. Both active foes have 4x OHKO moves. No win condition.

decisions.rationale: Helping Hand resolves before Arcanine-Hisui, then +1 Helping Hand Bullet Punch is guaranteed to exceed 32% even at maximum legal bulk. Bullet Punch also moves before Head Smash or Flare Blitz; only Extreme Speed or a reduced-success Protect can precede it.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 opposing four: Farigiraf, Kingambit, Mega Gardevoir, Arcanine-Hisui. Farigiraf: Quiet, Focus Sash, Armor Tail, Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Mega Gardevoir: Modest, Pixilate, Hyper Voice/Psychic/Mystical Fire/Protect. Arcanine-Hisui: Adamant, Expert Belt, Intimidate, Head Smash/Flare Blitz/Extreme Speed/Protect. Kingambit: Brave, Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord, Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Sucker Punch/Protect. Armor Tail blocks foe-targeted priority while Farigiraf remains. Preserve Basculegion when practical; after two allied faints, Adaptability Last Respects reaches 150 BP. Rain protects Metagross from Fire pressure and powers Politoed’s Weather Ball. Prankster Trick Room resolves at -6, before standard -7 Trick Room. Stomping Tantrum blocked by Protect does not gain doubled power. Unboosted Metagross Stomping Tantrum deals at least 36.9% to Farigiraf; rain-weakened Mega Gardevoir Mystical Fire deals about 21.9–25.8% to Metagross.

reflections.summary: The game was lost because the Trick Room strategy was countered by the opponent's dual speed control (Whimsicott's Tailwind and Trick Room) and rain-boosted offense. A critical misplay—double Protect by Gardevoir—allowed Metagross and Politoed to KO it early, breaking our offensive momentum. The team composition lacked a solid answer to Metagross's Stomping Tantrum and Politoed's Weather Ball under rain, and Kingambit likely fainted early due to a poor matchup.
reflections.adjustment: In team preview, reconsider bringing Kingambit and Gardevoir-Mega against this opponent. Instead, prioritize a bulkier, rain-resistant Pokémon and a more reliable Trick Room setter. Avoid double Protect turns; use redirection or switch to preserve Gardevoir. If Trick Room is key, ensure Farigiraf is protected from Stomping Tantrum with a switch or support move, and consider a different Mega Evolution that can operate under rain or speed control.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's team: Whimsicott (Prankster, Tailwind, Trick Room, Light Screen), Politoed (Drizzle, Helping Hand, Weather Ball), Metagross (Expert Belt, Stomping Tantrum, Bullet Punch), and likely Basculegion (rain sweeper) or Tsareena (Queenly Majesty). Tendencies: Whimsicott leads to set Tailwind, then switches; Politoed enables Metagross with Helping Hand; they aggressively target Trick Room setters with Stomping Tantrum. In future games, avoid bringing Kingambit and frail fast attackers without speed control; consider a Water resist or Wide Guard support. Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks priority but not Stomping Tantrum. Expect Tailwind/Trick Room reversals and rain-boosted priority. Future plan: lead with a counter-speed control option, use Protect sparingly, and preserve Farigiraf for late-game Trick Room.

reflections.summary: The no-Mega rain core was well suited to this matchup: rain reduced Fire pressure while Politoed and Metagross efficiently removed Mega Gardevoir, Farigiraf, and Arcanine-Hisui despite Trick Room.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the same four and no Mega, but make anti-Trick Room the primary plan: preserve Whimsicott to reverse an established Trick Room and remove Farigiraf before relying on Bullet Punch or Aqua Jet.
reflections.notebook: Opponent’s slow mode uses Mega Gardevoir with Farigiraf repeatedly establishing Trick Room. Armor Tail must be cleared before using foe-targeted priority. They may spend Trick Room turns with Protect. Rain-backed Metagross is a strong matchup centerpiece because rain limits Fire damage and Clear Body ignores Arcanine-Hisui’s Intimidate; retain this four-Pokémon, no-Mega plan and preserve Whimsicott for Trick Room reversal.
